mechanism: Celecoxib may increase chloroquine concentrations through CYP3A4 inhibition and both drugs can cause gastrointestinal irritation; chloroquine may increase celecoxib levels via protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor for chloroquine toxicity signs (visual disturbances, myopathy, arrhythmias); consider alternative NSAID or ensure adequate GI protection; regular ophthalmologic monitoring recommended.
